items.definition:
situated nearer to the center of the body or the point of attachment
The elbow is proximal to the hand.

involving or limited to basic principles; undeveloped
He has only a rudimentary understanding of the subject.

not mapped or surveyed; unknown
The explorers ventured into uncharted waters, hoping to discover new lands.

difficult to carry or handle because of size or weight
The old machinery was cumbersome and inefficient.

occurring in cycles; recurring
The economy often experiences cyclic patterns of growth and recession.

impossible to tell apart
The twins were almost indistinguishable from each other.

contrary to what is usual, traditional, or accepted
His teaching methods were considered unorthodox.

relating to or situated on an axis
The design included an axial fan for cooling.

deeply upset and agitated
She was distraught after hearing the bad news.

in the process of coming into being or becoming prominent
We are seeing emergent patterns in the data.

relating to politics and geography
The geopolitical landscape is constantly shifting.

exaggerated for effect
His description of the event was highly hyperbolic.

relating to or traveling between continents
They booked an intercontinental flight from Asia to Europe.

comprehensive; encompassing everything
The overarching theme of the conference was sustainability.

widespread, especially of something undesirable or harmful
The city was rife with rumors after the scandal.

Enduring pain and hardship without showing feelings or complaining
He remained stoic despite the bad news.

Not restrained or controlled
The unchecked spread of the disease caused concern.

Not secured or protected
The loan was unsecured, meaning no collateral was required.

Not able to be maintained at the current rate or level
Current levels of consumption are unsustainable.

Modeled on or aiming for a state in which everything is perfect; idealistic
He had a utopian vision for society.

having parts that fail to correspond to one another in shape, size, or arrangement; lacking symmetry
The building had an asymmetric design, with one side much taller than the other.

relating to or characteristic of an autobiography
Many of her novels contain autobiographical elements.

relating to birds
The avian flu outbreak caused concern among health officials.

characterized by or causing a rise in stock prices; optimistic or confident
Investors were bullish about the company's future prospects.

Relating to the art or practice of garden cultivation and management
She studied horticultural science at university.

relating to Freemasons or Freemasonry
The building had distinct masonic symbols on its facade.

relating to or based on observation
The study used an observational approach to gather data.

resolutely or dutifully firm and unwavering
He remained steadfast in his commitment to the project.

relating to or characteristic of a particular style or artistic movement
The painting has unique stylistic elements.

causing a marked change in someone or something
Education can be a truly transformative experience.

relating to the stars
He claimed to have an astral projection experience.

unable to be explained or accounted for
There was an inexplicable delay in the flight.

existing or taking place within, or administered into, a vein or veins
The patient received intravenous fluids.

relating to or expressing modality (in logic or grammar); relating to a mode or form
"Can" and "should" are examples of modal verbs.

relating to study or research carried out after completion of a doctorate
She is currently working as a postdoctoral researcher.

ridiculous, absurd
The idea of flying cars seemed preposterous just a few decades ago.

referred to in a proverb or idiom
He was caught between a rock and a hard place, the proverbial dilemma.

having or proceeding from an extreme or fanatical belief or attitude
The politician had a rabid following among his supporters.

(of a sound) deep, clear, and continuing to sound or reverberate
His voice was deep and resonant, filling the hall.

occurring or produced as a result of something
The resultant damage from the storm was extensive.

relating to the retina of the eye
The doctor performed a retinal examination.

relating to or suffering from schizophrenia; characterized by contradictory or antagonistic elements
The patient was diagnosed with a schizophrenic disorder.

dignified, majestic
The old mansion had a stately appearance.

relating to the structure of the earth's crust
The earthquake was caused by tectonic plate movement.

unequaled or unrivaled
Her talent is unmatched in the field.

not typical or usual
His behavior was atypical for someone his age.

giving advice or consultation
The committee has a consultative role.

changing frequently, especially as regards loyalties or affections
The weather here is notoriously fickle.

departing from a literal use of words
He used figurative language to describe his feelings.

full of (something bad); causing or affected by great anxiety or stress
The negotiations were fraught with difficulties.

relating to newborn children (or animals)
The hospital has a specialized neonatal intensive care unit.

relating to a neuron or neurons
Scientists are studying neuronal activity in the brain.

Firm in purpose or belief; determined.
She was resolute in her decision to pursue her dreams.

Most noticeable or important.
The salient features of the report were highlighted in the summary.

Representing in a simplified or diagrammatic form.
The engineer drew a schematic diagram of the circuit.

Able to perceive or feel things.
Many philosophers debate whether AI can ever become truly sentient.

happening or done at an unsuitable or unfortunate time
His untimely death shocked everyone.

Tending to cause corrosion; destructive to materials by chemical action
The acid was highly corrosive and ate through the metal.

Angry or dissatisfied
The disgruntled employees threatened to go on strike.

mysterious, puzzling
Her enigmatic smile left him wondering.

Of great importance or significance, especially in its bearing on future events
It was a momentous decision that would change their lives forever.

involving the participation of many people
The project adopted a highly participatory approach.

having or showing sharp powers of judgment
She made a shrewd investment that paid off handsomely.

existing, occurring, or done under the earth's surface
They explored the subterranean caves.
